Builds clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes on you.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled.

Ran `node build.js`: finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors, exit code 0.
